description: Get the full financial and delivery summary for one issued client invoice, including subtotal, markup, tax, advance applied, balance due, dates, status, source report, and private Google Doc/PDF/DOCX links when available. Provide invoiceId or invoiceNumber — one is required; invoiceNumber is accepted only when it is unique. Read-only.

invoiceId.description: Stable invoice ID from list_client_invoices. Required unless invoiceNumber is supplied.

invoiceNumber.description: Human invoice number when invoiceId is unavailable; it must identify one unique invoice.

name: get_client_invoice

invoice.description: The invoice record. Absent only on the error branch (not-found), which never carries structuredContent.
